name: dbml-canvas
description: Git-native DBML ERD renderer with portable layout files for web, VS Code, and JetBrains IDEs.

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:web && npm run build:webview && npm run build:vscode-host
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run build:renderer && npm run dev -w @dbml-canvas/web-sandbox
scripts.dev:webview: npm run build:core && npm run build:renderer && npm run dev -w @dbml-canvas/host-webview
scripts.build:vscode: npm run build:core && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:webview && npm run build:vscode-host
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run build:renderer && npm run typecheck -w @dbml-canvas/web-sandbox && npm run typecheck -w @dbml-canvas/host-webview && npm run typecheck -w dbml-canvas-vscode
scripts.test: npm run test:legal && npm run test -w @dbml-canvas/core && npm run test -w @dbml-canvas/renderer && npm run test -w @dbml-canvas/web-sandbox && npm run test -w @dbml-canvas/host-webview && npm run test -w dbml-canvas-vscode
